Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent or conscious disregard); inadvertently forgetting the stove is negligence, not recklessness, so A and C are legally wrong.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not treaties and do not always reflect custom; they are material sources that may enunciate or evidence customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” is conditional language plus a grantor’s elective right of entry, which is a fee simple subject to condition subsequent, not a determinable fee or executory interest.
